# Make targets

```text
  help                   📖  Show this help
  check-deps             🔍  Verify the script is executable and config exists
  wizard                 🧙  Interactive cluster.conf generator
  init                   🏗️   Clone Kubespray and generate inventory
  preflight              🩺  Check local tools + SSH connectivity
  deploy                 🚀  Full end-to-end cluster deployment
  deploy-remote          🚀  Alias for deploy (remote k3s platform)
  test-remote            🧪  Platform smoke tests (k3s)
  scale                  ➕  Add nodes from cluster.conf to the cluster
  upgrade                ⬆️   Upgrade Kubernetes to version in cluster.conf
  remove-node            ➖  Remove a node  (make remove-node NODE=worker2)
  fetch-kubeconfig       📥  Copy admin.conf from control-plane node
  merge-kubeconfig       🔀  Merge cluster kubeconfig into ~/.kube/config
  install-kubevirt       🖥️   Install KubeVirt operator + CDI on the cluster
  status                 📊  Show cluster node status (kubectl get nodes)
  destroy                💥  Destroy the cluster (requires confirmation)
  unlock                 🔓  Remove stale per-cluster lock after a crash
  dry-deploy             🔎  Dry-run deploy (prints plan, no changes)
  lint                   🔍  Run shellcheck on all scripts
  test-smoke             🧪  Quick CLI smoke test (help + config validation)
  test-inventory         🧪  Run inventory generation unit tests
  test-platform-config   🧪  Run k3s platform config unit tests
  test-platform-json     🧪  Run platform test JSON output unit tests
  test-local             🧪  End-to-end test via Multipass VMs (20–30 min)
  test-podman            🧪  Fast integration test via Podman containers + k3s
  desktop-dev            🖥️  Run Hypercluster Desktop (Tauri dev)
  desktop-build          🖥️  Build Hypercluster Desktop frontend
  desktop-check          🖥️  Typecheck + cargo check desktop app
  docs-venv              📚  Create Python venv for doc PDF generation
  docs                   📚  Generate docs + PDFs (_build/, guides, welcome.html, docs/pdf/)
  docs-serve             📚  Serve docs locally on port 8080
```
